picks.title: Introducing Specs: Markdown as a medium
picks.excerpt: Figma launches Specs, a Markdown container for context that lives on the canvas, giving designers and AI agents a shared written spec beside the design.
picks.rationale: Brand-new Figma product from Config India: a Markdown spec on the canvas that both designers and agents read, which changes how handoff context is written starting tomorrow.

picks.title: Bluesky's AI tool now lets you make games and apps to share on social
picks.excerpt: Bluesky's Attie tool now builds small games and apps from prompts that users share in their feeds; the CEO calls it 'vibe coding for your community.'
picks.rationale: New feature launch: prompt-built mini apps that live inside a social feed open a new surface for designing shareable interactive content.

picks.title: The AI you already use, now powering the apps you create
picks.excerpt: Lovable adds GPT-Live, the latest Claude models, Gemini 4 Argon, Gemini Omni, Lyria and more, so prompt-built apps can include voice, reasoning, video, music and live web research.
picks.rationale: Shipping release: designers prototyping in Lovable can now put voice, video, music and live research into the apps they build, not just static UI.

picks.title: Welcome FLUX.3 Image Klein in Diffusers
picks.excerpt: Black Forest Labs' open FLUX.3 Image Klein runs in Diffusers from day one: one model for text-to-image, multi-reference image-to-image and bounding-box layout control, about 2s per 1024px image on an H100, with FP8/NVFP4 weights for smaller GPUs.
picks.rationale: New open-weights small model with bounding-box layout control and quantized weights for consumer GPUs, so designers can run layout-controlled image generation locally.

picks.title: Hesai launches 3D data engine for physical AI
picks.excerpt: Hesai's Kosmo combines lidar scanning with cloud reconstruction to turn real spaces into robot-training 3D environments; a store deployment hit a 99% task success rate.
picks.rationale: New product launch: lidar-to-simulation 3D reconstruction pipeline, relevant to spatial and industrial designers building environments for physical AI.

alternates.rationale: Same Config India launch drop as Specs (same source, same event); held back under the content-hub rule. First swap-in if Specs is pulled.

alternates.title: Taste is not a design methodology
alternates.rationale: Essay, no event; distinct argument from the 09-23 Fast Company taste piece but lower novelty.

https://huggingface.co/blog/flux-3.new_action: New model release: the open-weights FLUX.3 Image Klein small model (with FP8/NVFP4 weights and bounding-box layout control) shipped with day-one Diffusers support. The 10-03 card covered the FLUX.3 Image launch, not Klein.

dedup.note: Dropped as already-published or same story: Engadget 'Adobe rebuilt Photoshop and Premiere for RTX Spark' and Creative Bloq 'I ran Blender via RTX Spark AI agent' (cluster c6). Both cover the RTX Spark creative-app launch already published 10-14 (NVIDIA 'All Systems Go: Global PC App Ecosystem Ready for RTX Spark'). Adobe's re-architecture is part of that ecosystem launch and the Blender piece is a hands-on, so neither is a new release. Creative Boom 'AI cloned Adobe's apps... Napster moment' is commentary on the 10-09 Creative Bloq Adobe-clones story, so it is the same story. Within-pool: dev.to 'Spec-driven development: the rise of Markdown' shares cluster c2 with Figma Specs, so I kept Specs. Figma 'Build by Design' roundup, 'code layers' and the Config India keynote YouTube video are the same Config India launch hub as Specs, so I kept only Specs and listed code layers as an alternate. Skipped on scoring/scope: Vercel MAI-Image-2.6 gateway listing (thin changelog), Dragon Quest 30-min AI game and Epic Disney AI game (games territory, both commentary), dev.to tattoo/storefront build logs (low credibility and novelty), and three UX Collective essays (no event). Diversity: 5 distinct outlets (Figma, The Verge, Lovable, Hugging Face, Engineering.com). Categories: figma x2 (the second gets palette accent #3b6bff), workflow, tokens, cad. Cross-section: the Bluesky Attie story was assigned to design by the orchestrator. Lovable and FLUX.3 Klein should be checked against other sections' picks before roll. Hugging Face and lovable.dev are not on the allowed_domains lists, but both are primary-source release posts.
